propositions: Seven full-route jobs have leading always() predicates that remain true during workflow cancellation, preventing GitHub from canceling stale matrix and reusable jobs when a new patchset supersedes the current one.

GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during cancellation; when predicates remain true, superseded jobs continue to natural completion rather than being canceled, causing runner-capacity waste (1785 runner-seconds and 1510 seconds of successor delay observed in run pair 31834162663 -> 31834896849).

The fix replaces only the cancellation status portion of the seven full-route job predicates with !cancelled() checks while preserving all existing clear-vote, ticket, classifier-result, and route conditions.
Classifier failure must still launch the full fallback route as a blocking result, independent of cancellation state.
Live post-merge same-change replacement evidence confirms stale jobs now end canceled promptly (61-96 seconds after replacement creation) without delaying successor job admission.
